'''''Secrets''''' is the title of two different chapters in ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series:

* The [[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 10|tenth chapter]] of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
* The [[Crossroads of Twilight/Chapter 17|seventeenth chapter]] of ''[[Crossroads of Twilight]]''.

==See also==
* The [[Thirteenth Depository]] - a secret section of hidden records in the [[Great Library]] of the [[White Tower]].
